headline: Public hearing on Green Street Manor, a four-unit project at 12 Green Street, Peace Dale; sign changes at People's Credit Union, 703 Kingstown Road.
summary: A public hearing covers a preliminary plan for two duplexes with parking and stormwater management. Other items include a sign request for People's Credit Union and the Old Tower Hill Road form-based code.
items: Public hearing on Green Street Manor, preliminary plan review for two duplexes (4 units) with parking and stormwater management at 12 Green Street, Peace Dale; continued from October 27, 2026
People's Credit Union, change to approved site plan to add a pylon sign and internal directional signage at 703 Kingstown Road; continued from October 27, 2026
Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code: discussion and next steps
Road/Farm Stands: general discussion of dimensional requirements
location: South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879

A. Call to Order & Roll Call: 
B. Subdivisions and Land Development Projects: 
 1. PUBLIC HEARING: Green Street Manor - Major Multi-household Land Development Project, Preliminary 
Plan Review, located at 12 Green Street, Peace Dale, Assessor's Plat 49-1, Lot 148. To construct two 
duplexes (4 units total) with associated parking and stormwater management.  Jonnycake Center for Hope, 
applicant/owner. (Continued from October 27, 2026) 
C. Development Plan Review: 
 1. People's Credit Union - Application for a Change to an Approved Plan. Applicant seeks approval to modify 
the previously approved site plan to add signage to include a pylon sign and internal directional signage. 703 
Kingstown Road, Assessor's Plat 51-1, Lot 92. Owner: People's Credit Union / Applicant: CT Sign. (Continued 
from October 27, 2026)  
D. Recommendations to Town Council: 
 1. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code- 
   a. Discussion and formulation of next steps. 
 2. Road/Farm Stands- 
   a. General discussion of dimensional requirements.
